name: learn-to-review
title_zh: 不替你判断的代码审查陪练
tagline_zh: 想练出挑毛病的眼力，又怕AI代劳让你变懒？它只给改动和提示，逼你自己找风险、缺陷和设计漏洞，练完还是你说了算。
tagline_en: Want sharper review skills without AI doing the thinking? It hands you changes and nudges, forcing you to spot.
desc_en: Practice reviewing code and agent-generated changes without outsourcing engineering judgment. Use when you want to improve at finding risks, defects, and design problems in a proposed change.
why_zh: 机制上拒绝替你做结论：只给练习材料和引导，不输出'这里有问题'的答案，逼你主动推理，真正长本事。
why_en: It refuses to hand you answers—just practice diffs and prompts, forcing your own reasoning so the skill sticks.
limit_zh: 只覆盖代码审查练习场景，不适用于真实代码库的审查；需要你已有基本代码阅读能力；不提供参考答案或评分。
limit_en: Only for practice, not real code reviews. Requires basic code reading skills. No answer key or scoring—you verify your findings yourself.
title_en: Code review practice that doesn't judge for you
